evals.name: no-signal-no-move
evals.prompt: Our Cratis application is one backend project with Feature/Slice folders and one team. A colleague wants to split it into six module projects now 'to be ready'. Advise. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Stay at one project until a signal appears; build structure only when a signal is present now. Consider at most naming a module folder when features group by capability.
assertions: Advises against splitting into module projects without a present signal.
Names concrete signals that would justify a move, such as a team boundary, entitlement gating or cross-module reaching.
Says one team with one capability starts as a single project with vertical slices.
Keeps the vertical slice as the unit at every stage.

evals.name: pin-identities-before-move
evals.prompt: We are moving the Billing feature folders into a new Billing module project and want namespaces to match the folders. Give the order of steps, including what protects our stored Chronicle events. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Pin event type and observer identities explicitly first and verify unchanged; then git mv only, one commit each, no behavior change, build and specs after each.
assertions: Pins event type and observer identities explicitly before any namespace or type rename.
Verifies discovered identities are unchanged after the pin.
Moves files with git mv in move-only commits without refactoring or behavior changes.
Runs build and specs after each step.

evals.name: cross-module-need
evals.prompt: The Orders module must react when Billing issues an invoice. A teammate proposes adding a project reference from Orders to Billing and using InternalsVisibleTo for one internal type. What do you do? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: No module reference and no InternalsVisibleTo; publish a Billing.Contracts project with the public event, Orders references only the contracts.
assertions: Rejects a project reference from one module to another module.
Rejects InternalsVisibleTo and says the code belongs lower or the dependency becomes a contract.
Introduces a Billing.Contracts project holding the public event with no logic.
Has Orders reference only the contracts project.

evals.name: ratcheting-gates
evals.prompt: Our architecture check counts seams and cross-module usings, and a pull request needs the baseline raised by two to pass. How should we handle it? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Baselines only shrink; never raise one. Fix the dependency or publish a contract, and tighten the baseline when coupling is removed.
assertions: Refuses to raise the baseline to land the change.
Says baselines only shrink and shrinking updates in the same change that removes coupling.
Directs fixing the dependency, a lower project or a contract instead.
Treats a temporary allowance as an owned seam with an exit.
